summary.title: HY-World 2.0: A Multi-Modal World Model for Reconstructing, Generating, and Simulating 3D Worlds

setting_and_object.category: System / Architecture (multi-stage generative-reconstructive world model framework)

details: 3D world modeling is split between generative methods (explorable scenes from sparse inputs, weak geometric accuracy) and reconstruction methods (accurate geometry from dense views, no generative priors), and the open-source community lacks a unified multi-modal system comparable to closed-source products like Marble.

HY-World 2.0: an open-source offline 3D world model that maps text, single image, multi-view images, or video to explorable 3DGS worlds via one pipeline — panorama generation (HY-Pano 2.0), scene-parsing-based trajectory planning (WorldNav), camera-guided generative world expansion (WorldStereo 2.0), and feed-forward 3D composition (WorldMirror 2.0) plus tailored 3DGS optimization.

Key mechanisms: (i) geometry-free perspective-to-equirectangular panorama synthesis by concatenating condition and panorama latents in an MMDiT; (ii) world expansion performed in a keyframe (spatial-only VAE) latent space rather than a spatio-temporally compressed video latent, conditioned by a global point-cloud memory (GGM) and retrieval-based spatially-stitched memory (SSM++); (iii) resolution-agnostic feed-forward reconstruction via normalized (coordinate-rescaled) RoPE with depth-to-normal coupling.

Trajectory planning: MoGe2-based panoramic point cloud (42 sampled views), SAM3/Qwen3-VL semantic parsing, Recast NavMesh; five heuristic trajectory modes (regular, surrounding, reconstruct-aware, wandering, aerial), up to 35 trajectories per scene.

WorldStereo 2.0 training: three stages — domain adaptation (camera adapter with Plücker rays + warped point clouds, freezing cross-attention and FFN of the DiT), middle-training with GGM/SSM++ and memory augmentations, and 4-step DMD distillation with full fine-tuning.

WorldMirror 2.0: normalized RoPE, depth-to-normal angular loss (GT normals for synthetic, monocular pseudo-normals for real data), depth-mask head, 3-stage curriculum, token-budget dynamic batching (e.g. 25K tokens/GPU, up to 48 views), UE synthetic renderings added; inference with token/frame sequence parallelism, BF16, FSDP.

World composition: WorldMirror depth aligned to panoramic point cloud via masked RANSAC linear (disparity-space) fit with outlier detection/replacement; 3DGS with view-independent RGB (no SH), sky/scene split densification, MaskGaussian pruning, depth+normal geometric losses, TSDF mesh extraction for collision.
Panorama: text-to-panorama and image-to-panorama, CLIP-T/CLIP-I and Q-Align quality/aesthetics on both equirectangular and 12 perspective projections.

World expansion: single-view generated 3D reconstruction on Tanks-and-Temples and MipNeRF360 (point-cloud precision/recall/F1/AUC vs MVS pseudo-GT); camera control on 100 out-of-distribution WorldScore images (RotErr/TransErr/ATE, Q-Align, CLIP-IQA+, LAION-Aes, CLIP-I, plus user study).

Reconstruction: point maps on 7-Scenes/NRGBD/DTU, pose+depth on RealEstate10K, NVS on RealEstate10K+DL3DV, normals on ScanNet/NYUv2/iBims-1, all at low (189x259), medium (378x518), high (756x1036) resolutions.
3DGS: ablation over 10 scenes with 20-view validation (PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS, Gaussian count); runtime on NVIDIA H20 GPUs.
Panorama: DiT360, Matrix3D, HY-World 1.0 (T2P); CubeDiff, GenEx, HY-World 1.0 (I2P).

Generation/expansion: SEVA, Gen3C, Lyra, FlashWorld, WorldPlay, WorldCompass, WorldStereo 1.0; composition compared to concurrent video2world; overall system compared qualitatively with closed-source Marble 1.0.
Reconstruction: Fast3R, CUT3R, FLARE, VGGT, pi^3, AnySplat, Pow3R, MapAnything, DepthAnything3, plus normal-estimation specialists (DSine, StableNormal, Omnidata).
Keyframe-VAE vs Video-VAE and which DiT parts to freeze (none / cross-attn / cross-attn+FFN).
Memory: GGM+SSM++, trainable FFN, point-cloud and reference augmentations, camera embeddings, spatial vs temporal concatenation of retrieved views, batch size 64, post-distillation.
3DGS: voxel downsampling, adaptive densification, MaskGaussian, sky-restricted densification.
Trajectory modes added incrementally (panorama only -> regular -> surrounding/recon -> wandering -> aerial).

key_findings.finding: Generating novel views in a keyframe (spatial-only compressed) latent space instead of a spatio-temporal video latent improves both visual fidelity and camera controllability.
key_findings.evidence: With Keyframe-VAE and freezing cross-attention+FFN, RotErr/TransErr/ATE drop from 0.762/1.245/2.141 (Video-VAE baseline) to 0.492/0.968/1.768, with user-study camera preference rising from 84.85% to 92.44% and quality preference from 46.46% to 64.39%; qualitative VAE comparisons show fewer motion-blur and distortion artifacts under fast camera motion.

key_findings.finding: Normalized (resolution-rescaled) RoPE removes WorldMirror's collapse at unseen inference resolutions, converting extrapolation into interpolation.
key_findings.evidence: At high resolution (756x1036), camera pose AUC@30 goes from 66.29 (v1) to 86.89 (v2), 7-Scenes point-map accuracy from 0.079 to 0.037, NVS PSNR from 17.78 to 19.98, and ScanNet normal mean error from 17.6 to 12.5; cross-resolution cosine similarity of RoPE encodings stays >0.95 versus significant degradation for absolute RoPE.

key_findings.finding: The full keyframe+memory expansion model yields the most geometrically consistent single-view-generated 3D structure, and DMD distillation to 4 steps preserves or slightly improves it.
key_findings.evidence: On Tanks-and-Temples, F1/AUC of 41.43/58.19 (43.16/60.09 distilled) versus best baselines Lyra 32.54/43.05, Gen3C 31.24/42.44, SEVA 36.73/51.03; on MipNeRF360 F1/AUC 51.27/65.79 versus FlashWorld 42.60/53.86. Memory ablation shows GGM+SSM++ raises PSNR from 16.13 to 20.94 and masked PSNR from 28.81 to 30.27, and post-distillation (config G) reaches PSNR 21.84 with comparable camera errors.

key_findings.finding: Spatially stitching each target frame with its retrieved reference view (SSM++) is essential; temporal concatenation of references degrades everything.
key_findings.evidence: Replacing spatial-stereo stitching with temporal concatenation drops PSNR 21.06 -> 19.83, SSIM 0.639 -> 0.581, LPIPS 0.164 -> 0.219 and worsens RotErr 0.329 -> 0.545, TransErr 0.042 -> 0.087, ATE 0.048 -> 0.114.

key_findings.finding: Sky-restricted densification combined with MaskGaussian resolves the efficiency-vs-detail dilemma in 3DGS trained on generated views.
key_findings.evidence: Across 10 scenes: full 6.0M-Gaussian baseline gives PSNR 25.176; voxel downsampling alone drops to 24.504 at 1.0M; densification restores 25.158 but inflates to 5.254M; adding MaskGaussian yields 25.017-25.023 with only ~1.38M Gaussians (77% fewer than baseline).
